answer: An attacker running 185 aliases therefore needs 27 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in lagoon, expire in atlas, and tundra lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2301 identities would post 1030 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
